description: This file defines the Currency model class in the OpenCart system, providing methods to interact with currencies in the database such as editing values, retrieving currencies by ID or code, and fetching all active currencies.

classes.name: Currency
classes.description: A model class for managing currency data within the localisation context in OpenCart.

methods.name: editValueByCode
methods.description: Updates the currency value in the database for a given currency code and clears the currency cache.

methods.name: getCurrency
methods.description: Retrieves a currency record by its ID.

methods.name: getCurrencyByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a currency record by its code.

methods.name: getCurrencies
methods.description: Retrieves all active currencies, utilizing caching for efficiency.
